scripts.dev: concurrently -n bot,web -c blue,yellow "nodemon apps/bot/src/index.js" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n bot,api,web -c blue,green,yellow "nodemon apps/bot/src/index.js" "nodemon apps/api/src/server.js" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['node_modules','apps/web/node_modules','apps/api/node_modules','apps/bot/node_modules','packages/database/node_modules','packages/shared/node_modules','packages/scripts/node_modules','packages/config/node_modules','.turbo']) { try { require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('removed', p); } catch (e) { console.log('skip', p, e.message); } }"
